objects.description: During the [2025 Poland Wiper Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0063), the adversaries used the [Rubeus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1071) tool to forge a Diamond Ticket that is a modified legitimate Kerberos ticket.(Citation: CERT Polska)(Citation: ESET DynoWiper Update JAN 2026)
